# Lab 4.8: Pipe Query Syntax

## What We Are Going to Do
Rewrite a nested standard query as a top-to-bottom pipe query using the `|>` operator.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Standard version.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT category, avg_margin
FROM (
  SELECT category, AVG(retail_price - cost) AS avg_margin
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
  WHERE department = 'Women'
  GROUP BY category
)
WHERE avg_margin &gt; 20
ORDER BY avg_margin DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Pipe version.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
|&gt; WHERE department = 'Women'
|&gt; EXTEND retail_price - cost AS margin
|&gt; AGGREGATE AVG(margin) AS avg_margin GROUP BY category
|&gt; WHERE avg_margin &gt; 20
|&gt; ORDER BY avg_margin DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Build a pipe query step by step.** Run only the first two lines, then add one `|>` line at a time and run again. Each step shows its intermediate result. This is the main teaching benefit.

4. **[SQL] Joins and windows in pipe syntax.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` AS o
|&gt; JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` AS u ON o.user_id = u.id
|&gt; WHERE u.country = 'India'
|&gt; AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS orders GROUP BY u.state
|&gt; EXTEND RANK() OVER (ORDER BY orders DESC) AS rnk
|&gt; WHERE rnk &lt;= 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Pipe syntax from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.shakespeare` |&gt; AGGREGATE SUM(word_count) AS words GROUP BY corpus |&gt; ORDER BY words DESC |&gt; LIMIT 3'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Same answer | Standard and pipe queries match |
| Reading order | Top to bottom, like the data flow |
| `EXTEND` | Adds columns you can use in later steps |
| Mixing | Pipe operators work after any standard query |
